fields.title: Okukulaakulana Okw’Omukisa
fields.summary: Ng’afumiitiriza ku Zabbuli Eyasooka, Taylor ageraageranya okukulaakulana okuva wansi — obuwanguzi obw’akaseera obw’ababi obutabula ennyo abaweereza ba Katonda — n’omukisa gw’omuntu asanyukira amateeka ga Mukama. Ng’asimbiddwa ku mabbali g’emigga gy’amazzi, omuntu oyo abala ebibala bye mu ntuuko zaabyo, era buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi.

study_questions.question: Taylor ayawula atya wakati w’engeri bbiri ez’okukulaakulana?
study_questions.answer: "Waliwo okukulaakulana okutaliimu mukisa: tekuva waggulu wabula wansi," era "kuggya omuntu ku ggulu" — okukulaakulana kwennyini Setaani kwe yalagaanyiza Kristo. Naye "waliwo okukulaakulana okw’amazima okuva gy’ali," okutayawukana ku "bwesimbu obutuukiridde n’obutukuvu obutakkiriziganya mu mutima ne mu bulamu."

study_questions.question: Lwaki Taylor alabula ku "kuteesa kw’abatatya Katonda," ne bwe kulabika ng’okw’amagezi?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga eri omubi "Katonda tali mu birowoozo bye byonna"; ababi babuulirira obwesimbu lwa kuba nti "ye ngeri esinga okuvaamu amagoba," so si lwa kusanyusa Katonda. Era kubanga Setaani "akozesa abantu ba Katonda ng’ebikwatirizo bye" (nga bwe kyali ku Peetero), "okuteesa kw’Abakristaayo abalowooza eby’ensi kukola akabi kangi nnyo okusinga okw’ababi abeeyolefu."

study_questions.question: Mikisa ki Taylor gy’aggya mu muti "ogwasimbibwa ku mabbali g’omugga"?
study_questions.answer: Obutebenkevu (omuti, so si "kimera obuti eky’ekiseera kimu"), ebigabwa ebyetongodde (amazzi amalamu ensulo eza bulijjo bwe zikalira), okubala ebibala mu ntuuko zaabyo (okufaanana Kristo, "ekiva ddala mu bulamu bwaffe bwennyini obukyusiddwa"), amaanyi agatakoma ("n’ebikoola byagwo tebiwotoka"), n’okukulaakulana okutakyukakyuka — "buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere."

study_questions.question: Taylor ayawula atya wakati w’"ekibala" n’"omulimu"?
study_questions.answer: "Omulimu guva mu kufuba; ekibala, mu bulamu. Omuntu omubi ayinza okukola omulimu omulungi, naye omuti omubi teguyinza kubala bibala birungi." Ekibala "kye kiva mu bulamu obuli munda mu ssanyu, mu ddembe, era mu ngeri ey’obutonde"; "tetuli bakozi abeetongodde" wabula "amatabi g’Omuzabbibu Ogw’amazima, ebitundu byennyini mwe gubalira ebibala byagwo."

fields.body_html:
Okufumiitiriza ku Zabbuli Eyasooka.

ENNYANJULA.

Waliwo okukulaakulana okutaliimu mukisa: tekuva waggulu wabula wansi, era kuggya omuntu ku ggulu, so si kumutwala gye liri. Okukulaakulana kuno okw’ababi emirundi mingi kutabula nnyo abaweereza ba Katonda; beetaaga okujjukizibwa ekigambo eky’okubuulirira nti, "Tofangayo ng’abalala bafunye ebirungi nga bayita mu kutetenkanya kwabwe okubi." Bangi okuggyako Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli bakwatiddwa obuggya eri abasirusiru bwe baalaba okukulaakulana kw’ababi, ne bakemebwa okubuuza nti, "Ali Waggulu Ennyo abitegeera?" Setaani bw’aba akyali katonda w’ensi eno, era ng’alina obuyinza okukulaakulanya abamusinza, ensonga eno ey’okutabulwa tejja kuggwaawo eri abo abatayingira mu kifo ekitukuvu ne balowooza ku nkomerero y’omuntu w’ensi.

Era si abatatya Katonda bokka abakemebwa okulagaanyizibwa okukulaakulana okuva wansi. Omulokozi waffe yennyini yakemebwa omulabe omukulu mu ngeri eno. Kristo yagambibwa nti byonna bye yayagala okukolera obwakabaka bw’ensi eno byali bisobola okutuukirizibwa mu kkubo ery’angu okusinga omusaalaba—okukkiriziganya akatono n’oyo eyalina obuyinza era eyali asobola okugaba obwakabaka, era byonna byandibadde bibye. Obukodyo obw’obulimba obw’omusendasenda Mukama waffe yabugaana amangu ddala; naye eri bangi ku bantu be obukodyo obwo tebulemererwa bwe butyo; akakodyo akatono mu kifo ky’ekkubo omuntu ow’omunda ly’amwegayirira; obutaba mwesimbu katono mu by’obusuubuzi; okukkiriziganya akatono n’empisa z’ensi, ne kuddirirwa okukulaakulana okutaleeta mukisa—bino bitera okulaga nti obukodyo bw’omulabe bukyali bwe bumu.

Naye, Katonda yeebazibwe! Waliwo okukulaakulana okw’amazima okuva gy’ali era okutwala omuntu gy’ali. Tekukoma ku kutabagana n’obwesimbu obutuukiridde n’obutukuvu obutakkiriziganya mu mutima ne mu bulamu, naye tekuyinza kufunibwa awatali byo, era okukunyumirwa kubyongera obuziba. Okukulaakulana kuno okw’obwakatonda kwe kigendererwa kya Katonda eri buli mukkiriza, mu byonna by’akola; mu bintu eby’omubiri ne mu by’omwoyo, mu nkolagana zonna n’ensonga z’obulamu buno, era ne mu mirimu gyonna egya Kristo n’egy’obulamu obutaggwaawo, Katonda ayagala buli mwana we nti "buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere."

Kyokka bangi ku baana be kyeyoleka nti tebanyumirwa mukisa guno ogutakyukakyuka; abamu basanga nga okulemererwa, so si okuwangula, ye mpisa y’obulamu bwabwe: ate abalala, oluusi nga bakulaakulana oluusi nga baggwaamu amaanyi, babeera mu bulamu obw’obutali bukakafu, mwe batera okubeera n’okweraliikirira, era n’okutya. Buli omu ku ffe tasaanidde okusooka okwebuuza nti, Nze ndi ntya? Okukulaakulana kuno okw’omukisa nkulaba mu bulamu bwange? Nkulemberwa Omwoyo bwe ntyo mu bye nkola, era Katonda ankulaakulanya bw’atyo mu biva mu byo, ne nsobola, nga ndi mujulirwa we, okutegeeza obwesigwa bwe ku kisuubizo kino? Bwe kiba si bwe kityo, nsonga ki? Bukwakkulizo ki obwetaagisa bwe nnemereddwa okutuukiriza? Okufumiitiriza kwaffe ku Zabbuli Eyasooka kutuyambe okutegeera obulungi obukwakkulizo buno, era okukkiriza kusobozesebwe okwetwalira mu bulambulukufu byonna ebiri mu kisuubizo kino eky’ekitalo!

OBUKWAKKULIZO OBW’OKWEWALA OBUTUUSA KU MUKISA

"Alina omukisa omuntu atatambulira mu kuteesa kw’ababi."

Mu bigambo ebisingako obutuufu, Ayi emikisa, essanyu ery’engeri ennyingi, ery’omuntu ono ow’empisa ezinnyonnyolwa wano mu lunyiriri olw’olubereberye n’olw’okubiri olwa Zabbuli eno! Alina essanyu mu by’awona oba by’eyewala, era alina essanyu n’okukulaakulana mu by’akola.

Embala esooka gye tuweebwa eri nti tatambulira mu kuteesa kw’abatatya Katonda, ababi. Weetegereze, tekyogera nti tatambulira mu kuteesa okubi: omuntu wa Katonda kya lwatu teyandikikoze; naye ekyogerwa kiri nti "atatambulira mu kuteesa kw’ababi." Kale ababi emirundi mingi babeera n’amagezi mangi ag’ensi, era ne bamanyibwa olw’okukulaakulana kwabwe n’obwegendereza bwabwe, naye omwana wa Katonda alina bulijjo okwekuuma eri okuteesa kwabwe; ne bwe kulabika nga kulungi, kujjudde akabi.

Emu ku mbala enkulu ez’omubi kwe kuba nti Katonda tali mu birowoozo bye byonna; alaba buli kimu ng’ayima mu kifo ky’okwerowoozaako, oba, ku ddaala erisinga obuwanvu, mu kifo ky’obuntu. Enjogera ye, "Faayo ku ow’olubereberye," yandibadde nnungi nnyo singa etegeeza nti Katonda ye ow’olubereberye, era bulijjo alina okusooka; naye si bw’atyo bw’agitegeeza: eri abatatya Katonda, kwerowoozaako, so si Katonda, ye ow’olubereberye. Ababi batera okubuulirira obwesimbu, si lwa nsonga nti obwesimbu busanyusa Katonda, wabula nti ye ngeri esinga okuvaamu amagoba; bwe kiba nti mu by’obusuubuzi ebimu ekkubo eddala erisinga amagoba lirabika nga teririimu kabi, abo ababadde abeesimbu lwa magoba banguwa nnyo okulekera awo.

Omwana wa Katonda teyeetaaga kuteesa kw’abatatya Katonda; bw’ayagala Ekigambo kya Katonda n’akisoma, kimufuula wa magezi okusinga ababuulirizi abo bonna. Bw’anoonya era n’akwata okuteesa kwonna okwa Katonda, ng’alungamizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, tajja kutambulira mu kizikiza wadde mu bintu eby’ensi. Ebiragiro by’Ekigambo kya Katonda biyinza okulabika ng’ebyewuunyisa era ebitali bya magezi, naye ng’okukkiriza kw’alina okugondera ebiragiro by’asanga mu Byawandiikibwa bwe kuli, nga takyamira ku ddyo wadde ku kkono, bw’atyo bw’anaakulaakulanya ekkubo lye, era bw’anaafuna obuwanguzi.

Ebyafaayo by’Ab’Emikwano (Friends) abaasooka mu Amerika, abaagaana okukwata ebyokulwanyisa okwekuuma eri ebika by’Abayindi ab’ettima, biraga nga bwe kiri ekitaliimu kabi okugoberera Ekigambo kya Katonda n’obutaziyiza bubi. Era bye baayitamu oluvannyuma mu Lutalo olw’Omunda olwaakaggwa, omutaafiira wadde omu ku bo, newaakubadde nga baali mu kabi akasingayo obunene n’obuzibu olw’okugaana okulwana, byongera okukakasa amagezi n’omukisa mu kugondera Ebyawandiikibwa nga bwe biri. Amaaso ga Mukama gakyatunuulira wonna mu nsi, okweraga nga wa maanyi ku lw’abo abamwesiga mu maaso g’abaana b’abantu. Omukkiriza eyamulisibwa alina okuteesa okusingako ennyo obulungi, ne kiba nti takyetaaga kuteesa kw’abatatya Katonda, era tekimusaanira kukwetoowaliza.

Era, okusinga ku ekyo, omwana wa Katonda ow’amagezi ajja kusooka okwekenneenya n’obwegendereza mukkiriza munne gy’ayimiridde nga tannaba kussa muwendo ku kuteesa kwe; kubanga ayiga okuva mu Byawandiikibwa ne mu bye yayitamu nti emirundi mingi Setaani akozesa abantu ba Katonda ng’ebikwatirizo bye, ng’ekyokulabirako, mu nsonga ya Peetero. Peetero eyeewuunya teyamanya n’akatono gye kwava okubuulirira kwe eri Mukama nti yeesaasire; "Dda ennyuma wange Setaani," kyalaga nti Mukama waffe yali azudde ensibuko ennamu ey’okuteesa kuno, okutaasooka kunoonya Bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Woowe, okuteesa kw’Abakristaayo abalowooza eby’ensi kukola akabi kangi nnyo okusinga okw’ababi abeeyolefu. Buli lwe tulaba ng’ebyo ebirowoozebwa okuba eby’omugaso eri omuntu yennyini, oba eri ab’omu nnyumba ye, oba eri ensi ye, oba ne eri ekkanisa oba omulimu gw’obuminsani bisooka, tuyinza okuba abakakafu ku nsibuko ennamu ey’okuteesa okwo; ku ddaala erisingayo wansi kuba kwa nsi oba kwa mubiri, bwe kutaba kwa Setaani.

Ate era, omuntu ddala alina omukisa—

Atayimirira mu kkubo ly’abalina ebibi.

Ebinyonyi eby’ebyoya ebifaanagana bibuukira wamu; ekkubo ly’omwonoonyi terisaanira mukkiriza wa mazima, nga n’ekkubo ly’omukkiriza bwe litasaanira mwonoonyi. Nga mujulirwa wa Mukama we, ng’asuubira okulokola ababula, ayinza okugenda gye bali; naye tajja, nga Lutti, kusimba weema ye ng’agitunuza e Sodomu; aleme okugwa mu mutego nga Lutti, eyawona yekka, ng’afiiriddwa bonna be yali asinga okwagala, n’ebintu bye byonna. Woowe, bazadde bameka abaawuluguttanga okumpi n’omuliro ng’ebiwojjolo, abalabye abaana baabwe nga gubazikiriza, ate bo bennyini ne batawona bisago! Kkanisa mmeka n’ebitongole by’Ekikristaayo, mu kugezaako okusikiriza abatakyuse n’ebisikiriza eby’ensi oba eby’okwesanyusaamu, bo bennyini abafiiriddwa omukisa gwa Katonda; ne bafiirwa amaanyi ag’omwoyo bwe batyo, ne kiba nti abo be baasikiriza tebaganyuddwa n’akatono! Mu kifo ky’okulaba abafu nga bazuukizibwa, embeera ey’okutongotoka n’okufa ebayingiddemu bo bennyini.

Tewali bwetaavu, wadde ebbanga, ery’ekisikiriza ekirala kyonna okuggyako ekyo Kristo yennyini kye yawa, bwe yagamba nti, "Bwe ndiwanikibwa ... ndiwalulira bonna gye ndi." Mukama waffe bulijjo yali "eyayawulibwa okuva ku abo abalina ebibi," era Omwoyo Omutukuvu ayogera mu ngeri etabuusibwabuusibwa mu 2 Abakkolinso 6: "Nkolagana ki eriwo wakati w’obutuukirivu n’obujeemu, oba kutabagana ki okuliwo wakati w’ekitangaala n’ekizikiza? ... Kubanga ffenna tuli Yeekaalu ya Katonda omulamu. Nga Katonda bwe yagamba nti, Nnaabeeranga mu bo era natambuliranga mu bo, nnaabeeranga Katonda waabwe, nabo banaabeeranga bantu bange. Noolwekyo muve wakati mu bo, mubeeyawuleko ... Temukwata ku bitali birongoofu, nange nnaabaaniriza. Era nnaabeeranga Kitammwe, nammwe ne mubeeranga batabani bange ne bawala bange, bw’ayogera Mukama Ayinzabyonna."

"Newaakubadde okutuula n’abo abanyooma ebya Katonda."

Entebe y’abanyoomi kye kimu ku bizibu eby’enjawulo eby’omulembe guno. Amalala, okwetulinkiriza, n’okunyooma bikwatagana nnyo, era biri wala nnyo n’endowooza eyali mu Kristo Yesu. Omwoyo guno gutera okweyoleka leero mu ngeri y’okunenya okutaliimu kitiibwa. Abo abasinga obutasaanira mu by’omwoyo basangibwa nga batudde ku ntebe y’okusala emisango, mu kifo ky’okutwala ekifo ky’oyo abuuza era ayiga. Ab’e Beroya ab’edda tebaagaana na kunyooma njigiriza z’Omutume Pawulo, ezaali empya gye bali, wabula baakeneenyanga Ebyawandiikibwa buli lunaku okulaba obanga ebyo bwe biri bwe bityo. Kaakano, mazima, Ebyawandiikibwa byennyini bibuusibwabuusibwa, era emisingi gyennyini egy’okukkiriza okw’Ekikristaayo girekebwa abantu abandyagadde okutwalibwa ng’abatume b’endowooza ez’omulembe guno. Katonda akuume abantu be baleme kuleka kukkiriza abatukuvu kwe baaweebwa omulundi ogumu, olw’ebirowoozo eby’ekiseera ebitaliiko musingi eby’omulembe guno!

OBUKWAKKULIZO OBW’OKUKOLA OBUTUUSA KU MUKISA.

Tulowoozezza ku bintu omuntu ddala alina omukisa by’eyewala. Ayi, ennaku n’okufiirwa kw’abo abalemererwa okubyewala! Kaakano tulina okulowooza ku mbala ez’enjawulo ez’omuntu wa Katonda, ezo ezibeera omulundi gumu ensibuko y’amaanyi ge n’engabo ye ey’obukuumi.

"Asanyukira okugondera amateeka ga Mukama;
"Era mu mateeka ago mw’alowooleza emisana n’ekiro."

Abatazaalibwanga mulundi gwa kubiri tebasobola kusanyukira mateeka ga Mukama. Bayinza okuba ab’eddiini ennyo, ne basoma Baibuli ng’emu ku mirimu gyabwe egy’eddiini. Bayinza okwewuunya bingi ebiri mu Baibuli, ne bagitendereza n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka—kubanga ng’ekitabo kyokka kye kisingayo okwewuunyisa mu nsi. Weewaawo, bayinza okusingawo; ne balowooza, nga Sawulo omuyigganya bwe yalowooza, nti obulamu bwabwe bulungamizibwa enjigiriza zaayo, so nga bakyali wala ne Katonda. Naye abantu ng’abo bwe bakyuka, bazuula nti babadde bazibe b’amaaso; mu "bintu byonna" ebifuuka ebiggya, basanga nga bafunye Baibuli empya; era ng’abaana abawere abaakazaalibwa beegomba amata ag’Ekigambo amalongoofu agatali matabule, balyoke bakulire omwo. Kirungi Abakristaayo abato bwe baliisibwa obulungi Ekigambo kya Katonda, n’obuwoomi bwabwe ne butayonoonebwa, wadde embeera yaabwe ey’omwoyo okuzikirizibwa, olw’okulya ebirowoozo by’abantu mu kifo ky’amazima ga Katonda.

Si kizibu kumanya omuntu ky’asanyukira. "Akamwa koogera ku biba bijjudde mu mutima." Maama asanyuka okwogera ku mwana we omuwere, omunnabyabufuzi ayagala okwogera ku byobufuzi, omunnassaayansi ku ssaayansi gy’asinga okwagala, n’omuzannyi ku muzannyo gwe. Mu ngeri y’emu Omukristaayo omunyiikivu era omusanyufu alaga essanyu lye mu Kigambo kya Katonda; kye kyokulya kye era ekimubudaabuda; kye kyokusoma kye era kye kimulungamya; era Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’ayaka ekitangaala ekiggya ku mazima gaakyo ag’omuwendo, akisangamu essanyu n’okunyumirwa ebitageraageranyizika. Mu ngeri ey’obutonde, ajja kutera okwogera ku ekyo eky’omuwendo ennyo eri omutima gwe.

Olw’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, omukkiriza, bw’amala okufuuka omwana wa Katonda, asanga eby’okwegomba n’okuyiga ebiggya mu mirimu gyonna egya Katonda. Kitaawe ye yagiteekateeka n’agitonda, agiwanirira era agikozesa, era gibeerawo olw’ekitiibwa kye. Naye kino kituufu nnyo naddala ku Kigambo kya Katonda. Ng’alina endowooza ya Kristo, ng’ayigirizibwa Omwoyo wa Kristo, asanga mu buli kitundu ky’Ekigambo kya Katonda obujulizi ku muntu ne ku mulimu gwa Mukama we era Mukwano gwe asaanidde okusinzibwa. Baibuli mu ngeri lukumi yeeyagaza gy’ali, nga bw’ebikkula endowooza n’amakubo ga Katonda, engeri gye yakolagananga n’abantu be mu biseera eby’edda, n’okubikkula kwe okw’ekitalo okw’ebiseera ebigenda okujja.

Bw’asoma bw’atyo Ekigambo kya Katonda, omukkiriza afuna ensibuko empya ey’essanyu; si ekyo kyokka ekibikkuliddwa kye kiba eky’omuwendo, naye n’obulungi n’obutuukirivu bw’okubikkula kwennyini byeyongera okumukwata. Teyeetaaga bujulizi obuva ebweru okukakasa nti kyaluŋŋamizibwa; wonna wonna kiriko akabonero k’Obwakatonda. Era nga ekyuma ekigaziya ebintu ebitono ennyo bwe kiraga obukalubo n’obulema bw’emirimu gy’omuntu naye ne kiraga mu bujjuvu okusingawo obutuukirivu bw’emirimu gya Katonda, ne kireeta mu lwatu obulungi obuggya obutalowoozebwangako, bwe kityo bwe kiri n’Ekigambo kya Katonda bwe kyekenneenyezebwa n’obwegendereza.

Ekitabo kino nga kyawukana ekitalo ku mirimu gy’abantu! Ssaayansi ow’eggulo talina mugaso leero; naye ebyafaayo n’ebizuuliddwa mu biseera byaffe bino bikakasa nti ebiwandiiko bino eby’edda ebitukuvu byesigika. Gye tukoma okuba n’okukkiriza okw’amaanyi nti Ekigambo kya Katonda Ekitukuvu kyaluŋŋamizibwa kyonna, buli kigambo kyakyo, era gye tukoma okukifuula omulagirizi waffe, era gye tukoma okugoberera enjigiriza zaakyo awatali kubuusabuusa, emirembe gyaffe gye ginaakoma okuba egy’obuziba n’obuweereza bwaffe okubala ebibala. "Abo abaagala amateeka go bali mu ddembe lingi; tewali kisobola kubeesittaza." Ng’agenda yeeyongera okukakasa amagezi ag’obwakatonda ag’ebiragiro n’amateeka g’Ebyawandiikibwa, n’okwesigika kw’ebisuubizo, obulamu bw’omukkiriza bujja kugenda bufuuka obw’obuwulize n’obwesige; era bw’atyo ajja kwekakasiza yekka nga Katonda by’ayagala bwe biri ebirungi, ebisiimibwa, era ebituukiridde, era ne Baibuli eyo ebibikkula.

Ebigambo, "amateeka ga Mukama," bye tutegeera okutegeeza Ekigambo kya Katonda kyonna, birimu amakulu mangi. Biraga nti Baibuli egenderera okutuyigiriza Katonda ky’ayagala tukole; nti tetusaanidde kunoonya bisuubizo byokka, n’okugezaako okufuna byonna bye tusobola okuva eri Katonda; naye okwegomba ennyo okusingawo okumanya ky’ayagala tubeere era kye tusaanidde okukola ku lulwe. Kyawandiikibwa ku Ezera nti yateekateeka omutima gwe okunoonya Etteeka lya Mukama, alyoke alikole, era ayigirize mu Isirayiri amateeka n’ebiragiro. Ekyavaamu kwe kuba nti omukono gwa Katonda we gwali ku ye olw’obulungi, ebyo omutima gwe bye gwegomba ne bimuweebwa mu bungi, n’afuuka omukutu gw’omukisa eri abantu be bonna. Buli anoonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa mu mwoyo gwe gumu ajja kufuna omukisa gwa Katonda n’agugabira n’abalala: ajja kusangamu obulagirizi bw’ayetaaga ku lw’obuweereza bwe yennyini, era emirundi mingi ekigambo eky’omu kiseera ekituufu eri abo b’akolagana nabo.

Naye Baibuli tejja kumubeerera Mateeka ga Mukama mu kumuyigiriza Katonda by’ayagala abeere era akole kyokka, naye okusingawo mu kubikkula Katonda yennyini ky’ali era by’akola. Nga etteeka ly’obuzito (gravitation) bwe lituleetera okumanya engeri amaanyi ge tuyinza okwesiga bulijjo gye ganaakolamu mu mbeera ezimu, bwe gatyo Amateeka ga Mukama gatuleetera okumumanya ye, n’emisingi gy’obufuzi bwe, gye tuyinza okwesiga n’obwesige obutaliimu kubuusabuusa.

Omuntu wa Katonda ajja kusanyuka okulondoola Katonda mu Kigambo ng’Omukozi omukulu, era asanyukire enkizo ey’okuba omukozi awamu naye—omukozi omusanyufu ow’okwagala kwe mu kukola Katonda by’ayagala, kyokka ng’asanyukira ekisa ekimufudde omwagazi, n’amaanyi ag’obwakatonda ag’ensusso agakolera mu ye. Baibuli era ejja kumuyigiriza okwetunuulira ng’akasirikitu kokka, nga bwe kyandigambiddwa, mu nsi yonna ennene eya Katonda; n’okulaba omulimu omunene ogwa Katonda ng’ekintu ekimu ekijjuvu eky’ekitalo, ekikolebwa okuyita mu mikutu emitwalo n’emitwalo; mu bifo byonna, mu biseera byonna, era awatali kusoboka kulemererwa ku nkomerero—okweyoleka okw’ekitiibwa okw’obutuukirivu bw’Omukozi omukulu! Ye, n’abaweereza banne abalala lukumi, bayinza okuggwaawo; naye ekirowoozo kino tekijja kulemaza kufuba kwe, kubanga amanyi nti kyonna ekikoleddwa mu Katonda kijja kubeerawo, era nti kyonna ekitannaggwa ng’omulimu gwe guwedde, Omukozi omukulu ajja kukimaliriza mu kiseera kye era mu ngeri ye.

Tasuubira kutegeera byonna ebikwata ku mulimu omunene ogwo gw’aweereddwa enkizo okutwalamu ekitundu eky’omukisa naye ekitono ennyo; asobola okulindirira okuggwa kwagwo, era asobola dda okusanyuka olw’okukkiriza mu bukakafu nti gwonna gulisangibwa nga gusaanira mu buli ngeri Omuteesi omukulu era Omutuukiriza waagwo. Kya nsonga essanyu lye okuba mu Mateeka ga Mukama, n’okugalowoolezaamu emisana n’ekiro.

EBIVAAMU EBY’OMUKISA.

Kaakano tweyongerayo okulaba ebisuubizo eby’ekitalo ebiri mu lunyiriri olw’okusatu olwa Zabbuli eno—kimu ku bisinga okwewuunyisa era okuzingiramu ebingi ebiri mu Byawandiikibwa:—

"Afaanana ng’omuti ogwasimbibwa ku mabbali g’omugga,
"Ogubala ebibala byagwo mu ntuuko zaabyo,
"N’ebikoola byagwo tebiwotoka.
"Na buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere."

Singa twali tusobola okuwa abatatya Katonda enteekateeka ey’ensi ekakasa nti bajja kukulaakulana mu byonna bye bakola, nga bandigisembezza n’amaanyi! Naye Katonda yennyini bw’abikkulira abantu be enteekateeka ekola ddala, nga batono abagikozesa! Bangi balemererwa ku ludda olw’okwewala ne batava mu nsi mu lwatu; bangi balemererwa ku ludda olw’okukola ne bakkiriza emirimu emirala oba okwesanyusa okutwala ebiseera ebyandiweereddwa okusoma n’okufumiitiriza ku Kigambo kya Katonda. Eri abamu si kyangu okufuna ebiseera eby’okutunula ku makya, naye tewali kiyinza kuliyirira kufiirwa kwabyo. Naye tewali kibinja kya kusatu ky’Abakristaayo ng’okulemererwa kwabwe okusinga kuva mu butakwata kisuubizo ne bakyetwalira olw’okukkiriza? Mu buli emu ku ngeri zino essatu okulemererwa kuyinza okuyingira, n’emikisa egy’endagaano ne gifiirwa.

Kale kaakano tulowooze emikisa gye giri, essanyu ery’engeri ennyingi, okukkiriza lye kulina okwetwalira obukwakkulizo bwe bumala okutuukirizibwa.

I. Obutebenkevu.—Afaanana ng’omuti (so si kimera obuti eky’ekiseera kimu), ogukula mpola nga gweyongera okubala ebibala. Omuti ogwasimbibwa, era ogusangibwa bulijjo mu kifo kyagwo, ogutawuubwawuubwa mpewo, nga si kya kuzannyisa mu mbeera. Ebimuli biyinza okumulisa ne biggwaawo, naye omuti gubeerawo.

II. Ebigabwa Ebyetongodde.—Ogwasimbibwa ku mabbali g’emigga gy’amazzi. Ebigabwa ebya bulijjo eby’enkuba n’omusulo biyinza okuggwaawo: ebigabwa bye eby’obuziba era ebikwekeddwa tebisobola. Tajja kweraliikirira mu mwaka ogw’ekyeya, era mu nnaku ez’enjala ajja kukkuta. Ekigabwa kye ge mazzi amalamu—Omwoyo wa Katonda—oyo atakyukakyuka, eggulo, leero, n’emirembe gyonna: kyava aba nga tasinziira ku nsulo ekulukuta oluusi n’ekalira oluusi.

III. Okubala Ebibala mu Ntuuko Zaabyo.—Omuyizi w’Ebyawandiikibwa omwegendereza alaba okufaanagana wakati w’enjigiriza ya Zabbuli Eyasooka n’eya Mukama waffe mu Njiri ya Yokaana, gye tuyigirizibwa mu ssuula ey’omukaaga nti oyo alya Kristo abeera mu ye, ne mu ey’ekkumi n’ettaano nti oyo abeera mu ye abala ebibala bingi. Tulya Kristo, Kigambo eyafuuka omubiri, okuyita mu Kigambo ekyawandiikibwa. Bwe kityo ne mu Zabbuli eno, oyo asanyukira amateeka ga Mukama, n’agafumiitirizaako emisana n’ekiro, abala ebibala bye mu ntuuko zaabyo.

Kino kirungi. Ekigambo ekyogeddwa mu kiseera ekituufu nga kirungi; era nga n’okutunula okw’omu kiseera ekituufu kuyinza okuzzaamu amaanyi oba okuziyiza, okunenya oba okubudaabuda! Ekisuubizo kino kijjukiza ebyo ebiri mu Yokaana ebikwata ku mazzi amalamu: abalumwa ennyonta bagenywa, ne batakoma ku kuweweera bokka, naye ne bafuuka emikutu emigga gy’amazzi amalamu mwe gikulukutira bulijjo, abalala abalumwa ennyonta balyoke bafune okuweweera okw’omu kiseera ekituufu mu ssaawa yaabwe ey’obwetaavu. Naye ekifaananyi ekiri mu Zabbuli si kya mazzi agakulukutira mu ffe ng’agayita mu mukutu; wabula kya kibala, ekiva ddala mu bulamu bwaffe bwennyini obukyusiddwa—obulamu obw’okwegatta ne Kristo.

Kisa kinene nnyo eri Katonda waffe obutakolera mu ffe mu ngeri ya kyuma bwereere, wabula okutufuula amatabi g’Omuzabbibu Ogw’amazima, ebitundu byennyini mwe gubalira ebibala byagwo. Noolwekyo, tetuli bakozi abeetongodde, kubanga waliwo enjawulo ey’omusingi wakati w’ekibala n’omulimu. Omulimu guva mu kufuba; ekibala, mu bulamu. Omuntu omubi ayinza okukola omulimu omulungi, naye omuti omubi teguyinza kubala bibala birungi. Ekiva mu mulimu tekizaala, naye ekibala kirina ensigo yaakyo mu kyo kyennyini. Omukozi alina okunoonya ebikozesebwa bye n’ebyuma bye, era emirundi mingi okwewaayo eri omulimu gwe n’okugumiikiriza okulumya. Ekibala ky’Omuzabbibu kye kiva mu bulamu obuli munda mu ssanyu, mu ddembe, era mu ngeri ey’obutonde; era kitondekebwa ne kikula ne kyengera mu ntuuko zaakyo.

Era kibala ki omukkiriza ky’asaanidde okubala? Tekiyinza kwogerwako mu kigambo kimu—okufaanana Kristo? Kisanyusa okwetegereza nti Ebyawandiikibwa tebyogera ku bibala by’Omwoyo, mu bungi, nga gy’obeera nti tuyinza okwerondera ku bisa ebyo ebyogeddwako, wabula ku kibala, mu kimu, ekiri ekirimba ekijjuvu ekikoleddwa mu kwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, n’ebirala. Nga kya mukisa okubala ebibala ng’ebyo mu ntuuko zaabyo!

IV. Amaanyi Agatakoma.—"N’ebikoola byagwo tebiwotoka." Mu mbeera y’obudde ey’ewaffe emiti mingi gisobola okukuuma obulamu bwagyo okuyita mu biseera eby’obutiti, naye ne gitasobola kukuuma bikoola byagyo. Kyokka omuti ogugumu ogutakyusa bikoola, si ku kuba omulamu kwokka, naye gwolesa obulamu bwagwo, era okusingawo mu lwatu olw’amatabi ag’obwereere agaguli okumpi. Obulamu obuli munda bwa maanyi ne butatya lunaku olumpimpi, empewo ennyogovu, wadde omuzira ogugwa. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’omuntu wa Katonda obulamu bwe obukuumibwa olw’okukolagana okukwekeddwa okuyita mu Kigambo; okubonaabona kuleeta bulesi mu lwatu amaanyi n’amazima g’obulamu obuli munda.

Ekikoola ky’omuti si kya kwewunda bwewunda. Obanga emirandira gitujjukiza amaanyi ag’okufuna kubanga gisika okuva mu ttaka amazzi g’omuti agazzaamu amaanyi, obulamu bwe butandisobodde kukuumibwa awatali go, n’ebikoola tebitujjukiza kitono ekisa ky’okugaba, n’eky’okulongoosa. Biwa empewo obunnyogovu obuweweeza; biwa omutambuze ekisiikirize ekiweweeza, era birongoosa empewo eyonooneddwa okussa kw’ebiramu.

Era omuti gusasulwa bulungi olw’ebyo byonna bye guwaayo okuyita mu bikoola byagwo. Amazzi g’omuti agatali makwafu agazzaamu amaanyi agava mu mirandira, agatandisobodde gokka kuzimba muti, geeyongera obukwafu mu kuwaayo obunnyogovu bwago, era okuyita mu bikoola ne geefunira kaboni okuva mu mpewo. Bwe gagaggawazibwa, amazzi g’omuti gaddayo okuyita mu muti, nga gaguzimba okutuusa obulandira obusinga obutono nga buliisibwa ebikoola nga ebikoola bwe biriisibwa emirandira. Kuuma omuti nga gwambuddwako ebikoola byagwo okumala ebbanga eriwanvu ekimala, era gujja kufa. Bwe kityo omukkiriza bw’ataba ng’agaba era ng’afuna, ng’alongoosa obulamu bwe n’obuyinza bw’alina ku balala, tasobola kukula wadde okukuuma obulungi amaanyi g’obulamu bwe. Naye oyo asanyukira amateeka ga Mukama, n’agalowoolezaamu emisana n’ekiro—ebikoola bye tebiriwotoka.

V. Okukulaakulana Okutakyukakyuka.—"Na buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere." Waliwo ekisuubizo ekiyinza okusukka kino? Kye kirabo eky’enjawulo eky’omwana wa Katonda okulaba omukono gwa Katonda mu mbeera ze zonna n’ebimwetoolodde, n’okuweereza Katonda mu mirimu gye gyonna n’obuvunaanyizibwa bwe. Ne bw’alya oba bw’anywa, bw’akola oba bw’awummula, bw’ayogera oba bw’asirika; mu mirimu gye gyonna, egy’omwoyo, egy’awaka, oba egy’ensi, aba mu ngeri y’emu omuweereza wa Katonda. Tewali kintu ekikkirizibwa gy’ali ekitono ennyo okuba nga tekiyinza kumuwa kakisa ka kugulumiza Katonda; emirimu egyandibadde emitono oba egikooya mu gyo gyokka gigulumizibwa ne giweebwa ekitiibwa omukkiriza bw’ategeera nti mu gyo asobola okusanyusa n’okumatiza omutima ogw’okwagala ogwa Mukama we atunula bulijjo. Era oyo amanyi mu byonna nti muweereza wa Katonda ayinza okwesiga okufuna ebimumala okuva eri Katonda olw’obwetaavu bwonna, era n’atunuulira eri Katonda n’essuubi eryesigika nti ddala anaamukulaakulanya mu buli ky’akola.

Naye okukulaakulana kuno tekujja kulabika bulijjo, okuggyako eri eriiso ly’okukkiriza. Kolaziini ne Besusayida bwe baagaana obubaka bwa Mukama waffe, kyetaagisa eriiso ly’okukkiriza okusanyuka mu mwoyo n’okugamba nti, "Weewaawo Kitange, bw’otyo bwe wasiima." Tewali kubuusabuusa nti eggye ly’emisambwa gya ggeyeena lyajaganya bwe lyalaba Mukama ow’Ekitiibwa ng’akomererwa ku muti ogwakolimirwa; naye tumanyi nti tewali kiseera Mukama waffe ow’omukisa lwe yakulaakulana okusinga lwe yeewaayo yekka, nga Kabona waffe Asinga Obukulu, okuba ssaddaaka yaffe etutangirira, n’asitula ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe ku muti. Nga bwe kyali olwo, bwe kiri ne kaakano, ekkubo ly’okukulaakulana okw’amazima litera okuyita mu kubonaabona okusingayo obuziba; abagoberezi ba Kristo basaanidde okumatira n’ekkubo lye yatambulirako.

Naye newaakubadde nga okukulaakulana kuno kuyinza obutalabika mangu, bulijjo kunaabanga kwa mazima, era kusaanidde bulijjo okwetwalirwa olw’okukkiriza. Omusumba mu kkanisa ye, omuminsani mu bantu abatamanyi Katonda, omusuubuzi ku mmeeza ye, maama mu maka ge, omukozi mu mulimu gwe, buli omu ku bo ayinza mu ngeri y’emu okukwetwalira. Si kwa bwereere nti kyawandiikibwa nti, "Na buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere."

VI. Ekisembayo, twetegereze nti ebisuubizo bino byonna biri mu ngeri ey’okutegeeza ekiriwo (indicative mood), era, kasita obukwakkulizo butuukirizibwa, tebiriimu kubuusabuusa. Tebiriimu "oboolyawo" yonna. Era ate, bikolebwa eri abakkiriza kinoomu. Abakkiriza abalala bwe balemererwa, oyo abikkiriza ye tajja kulemererwa; ekigambo kiri nti, "Na buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere."

ENJAWULO.

"Abakola ebibi tebakola bwe batyo."

Tekyetaagisa kulwawo ku njawulo eno. Abatatya Katonda tebayinza kunyumirwa ssanyu ly’omwana wa Katonda, kubanga tebasobola kutuukiriza bukwakkulizo. Tebasobola, era tebaagala, kwewala kuteesa, kibiina, wadde amakubo ga banaabwe; era tebalina kulaba okw’omwoyo okwetaagisa okusanyukira Ekigambo kya Katonda. Mu kifo ky’okujjula obulamu, ng’empeke ezikyali ennyogovu, bakakanyala ne bakala; era omusana gwe gumu ogwengeza emu gutegeka endala okuzikirizibwa. Mu kifo ky’okuba nga "basimbiddwa," empewo ebafuumuula; era Oyo asanyukira ekkubo ly’abantu be, aleetera ekkubo ly’abatatya Katonda okubula.
fields.body_text: Okufumiitiriza ku Zabbuli Eyasooka. ENNYANJULA. Waliwo okukulaakulana okutaliimu mukisa: tekuva waggulu wabula wansi, era kuggya omuntu ku ggulu, so si kumutwala gye liri. Okukulaakulana kuno okw’ababi emirundi mingi kutabula nnyo abaweereza ba Katonda; beetaaga okujjukizibwa ekigambo eky’okubuulirira nti, "Tofangayo ng’abalala bafunye ebirungi nga bayita mu kutetenkanya kwabwe okubi." Bangi okuggyako Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli bakwatiddwa obuggya eri abasirusiru bwe baalaba okukulaakulana kw’ababi, ne bakemebwa okubuuza nti, "Ali Waggulu Ennyo abitegeera?" Setaani bw’aba akyali katonda w’ensi eno, era ng’alina obuyinza okukulaakulanya abamusinza, ensonga eno ey’okutabulwa tejja kuggwaawo eri abo abatayingira mu kifo ekitukuvu ne balowooza ku nkomerero y’omuntu w’ensi. Era si abatatya Katonda bokka abakemebwa okulagaanyizibwa okukulaakulana okuva wansi. Omulokozi waffe yennyini yakemebwa omulabe omukulu mu ngeri eno. Kristo yagambibwa nti byonna bye yayagala okukolera obwakabaka bw’ensi eno byali bisobola okutuukirizibwa mu kkubo ery’angu okusinga omusaalaba—okukkiriziganya akatono n’oyo eyalina obuyinza era eyali asobola okugaba obwakabaka, era byonna byandibadde bibye. Obukodyo obw’obulimba obw’omusendasenda Mukama waffe yabugaana amangu ddala; naye eri bangi ku bantu be obukodyo obwo tebulemererwa bwe butyo; akakodyo akatono mu kifo ky’ekkubo omuntu ow’omunda ly’amwegayirira; obutaba mwesimbu katono mu by’obusuubuzi; okukkiriziganya akatono n’empisa z’ensi, ne kuddirirwa okukulaakulana okutaleeta mukisa—bino bitera okulaga nti obukodyo bw’omulabe bukyali bwe bumu. Naye, Katonda yeebazibwe! Waliwo okukulaakulana okw’amazima okuva gy’ali era okutwala omuntu gy’ali. Tekukoma ku kutabagana n’obwesimbu obutuukiridde n’obutukuvu obutakkiriziganya mu mutima ne mu bulamu, naye tekuyinza kufunibwa awatali byo, era okukunyumirwa kubyongera obuziba. Okukulaakulana kuno okw’obwakatonda kwe kigendererwa kya Katonda eri buli mukkiriza, mu byonna by’akola; mu bintu eby’omubiri ne mu by’omwoyo, mu nkolagana zonna n’ensonga z’obulamu buno, era ne mu mirimu gyonna egya Kristo n’egy’obulamu obutaggwaawo, Katonda ayagala buli mwana we nti "buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere." Kyokka bangi ku baana be kyeyoleka nti tebanyumirwa mukisa guno ogutakyukakyuka; abamu basanga nga okulemererwa, so si okuwangula, ye mpisa y’obulamu bwabwe: ate abalala, oluusi nga bakulaakulana oluusi nga baggwaamu amaanyi, babeera mu bulamu obw’obutali bukakafu, mwe batera okubeera n’okweraliikirira, era n’okutya. Buli omu ku ffe tasaanidde okusooka okwebuuza nti, Nze ndi ntya? Okukulaakulana kuno okw’omukisa nkulaba mu bulamu bwange? Nkulemberwa Omwoyo bwe ntyo mu bye nkola, era Katonda ankulaakulanya bw’atyo mu biva mu byo, ne nsobola, nga ndi mujulirwa we, okutegeeza obwesigwa bwe ku kisuubizo kino? Bwe kiba si bwe kityo, nsonga ki? Bukwakkulizo ki obwetaagisa bwe nnemereddwa okutuukiriza? Okufumiitiriza kwaffe ku Zabbuli Eyasooka kutuyambe okutegeera obulungi obukwakkulizo buno, era okukkiriza kusobozesebwe okwetwalira mu bulambulukufu byonna ebiri mu kisuubizo kino eky’ekitalo! OBUKWAKKULIZO OBW’OKWEWALA OBUTUUSA KU MUKISA "Alina omukisa omuntu atatambulira mu kuteesa kw’ababi." Mu bigambo ebisingako obutuufu, Ayi emikisa, essanyu ery’engeri ennyingi, ery’omuntu ono ow’empisa ezinnyonnyolwa wano mu lunyiriri olw’olubereberye n’olw’okubiri olwa Zabbuli eno! Alina essanyu mu by’awona oba by’eyewala, era alina essanyu n’okukulaakulana mu by’akola. Embala esooka gye tuweebwa eri nti tatambulira mu kuteesa kw’abatatya Katonda, ababi. Weetegereze, tekyogera nti tatambulira mu kuteesa okubi: omuntu wa Katonda kya lwatu teyandikikoze; naye ekyogerwa kiri nti "atatambulira mu kuteesa kw’ababi." Kale ababi emirundi mingi babeera n’amagezi mangi ag’ensi, era ne bamanyibwa olw’okukulaakulana kwabwe n’obwegendereza bwabwe, naye omwana wa Katonda alina bulijjo okwekuuma eri okuteesa kwabwe; ne bwe kulabika nga kulungi, kujjudde akabi. Emu ku mbala enkulu ez’omubi kwe kuba nti Katonda tali mu birowoozo bye byonna; alaba buli kimu ng’ayima mu kifo ky’okwerowoozaako, oba, ku ddaala erisinga obuwanvu, mu kifo ky’obuntu. Enjogera ye, "Faayo ku ow’olubereberye," yandibadde nnungi nnyo singa etegeeza nti Katonda ye ow’olubereberye, era bulijjo alina okusooka; naye si bw’atyo bw’agitegeeza: eri abatatya Katonda, kwerowoozaako, so si Katonda, ye ow’olubereberye. Ababi batera okubuulirira obwesimbu, si lwa nsonga nti obwesimbu busanyusa Katonda, wabula nti ye ngeri esinga okuvaamu amagoba; bwe kiba nti mu by’obusuubuzi ebimu ekkubo eddala erisinga amagoba lirabika nga teririimu kabi, abo ababadde abeesimbu lwa magoba banguwa nnyo okulekera awo. Omwana wa Katonda teyeetaaga kuteesa kw’abatatya Katonda; bw’ayagala Ekigambo kya Katonda n’akisoma, kimufuula wa magezi okusinga ababuulirizi abo bonna. Bw’anoonya era n’akwata okuteesa kwonna okwa Katonda, ng’alungamizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, tajja kutambulira mu kizikiza wadde mu bintu eby’ensi. Ebiragiro by’Ekigambo kya Katonda biyinza okulabika ng’ebyewuunyisa era ebitali bya magezi, naye ng’okukkiriza kw’alina okugondera ebiragiro by’asanga mu Byawandiikibwa bwe kuli, nga takyamira ku ddyo wadde ku kkono, bw’atyo bw’anaakulaakulanya ekkubo lye, era bw’anaafuna obuwanguzi. Ebyafaayo by’Ab’Emikwano (Friends) abaasooka mu Amerika, abaagaana okukwata ebyokulwanyisa okwekuuma eri ebika by’Abayindi ab’ettima, biraga nga bwe kiri ekitaliimu kabi okugoberera Ekigambo kya Katonda n’obutaziyiza bubi. Era bye baayitamu oluvannyuma mu Lutalo olw’Omunda olwaakaggwa, omutaafiira wadde omu ku bo, newaakubadde nga baali mu kabi akasingayo obunene n’obuzibu olw’okugaana okulwana, byongera okukakasa amagezi n’omukisa mu kugondera Ebyawandiikibwa nga bwe biri. Amaaso ga Mukama gakyatunuulira wonna mu nsi, okweraga nga wa maanyi ku lw’abo abamwesiga mu maaso g’abaana b’abantu. Omukkiriza eyamulisibwa alina okuteesa okusingako ennyo obulungi, ne kiba nti takyetaaga kuteesa kw’abatatya Katonda, era tekimusaanira kukwetoowaliza. Era, okusinga ku ekyo, omwana wa Katonda ow’amagezi ajja kusooka okwekenneenya n’obwegendereza mukkiriza munne gy’ayimiridde nga tannaba kussa muwendo ku kuteesa kwe; kubanga ayiga okuva mu Byawandiikibwa ne mu bye yayitamu nti emirundi mingi Setaani akozesa abantu ba Katonda ng’ebikwatirizo bye, ng’ekyokulabirako, mu nsonga ya Peetero. Peetero eyeewuunya teyamanya n’akatono gye kwava okubuulirira kwe eri Mukama nti yeesaasire; "Dda ennyuma wange Setaani," kyalaga nti Mukama waffe yali azudde ensibuko ennamu ey’okuteesa kuno, okutaasooka kunoonya Bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Woowe, okuteesa kw’Abakristaayo abalowooza eby’ensi kukola akabi kangi nnyo okusinga okw’ababi abeeyolefu. Buli lwe tulaba ng’ebyo ebirowoozebwa okuba eby’omugaso eri omuntu yennyini, oba eri ab’omu nnyumba ye, oba eri ensi ye, oba ne eri ekkanisa oba omulimu gw’obuminsani bisooka, tuyinza okuba abakakafu ku nsibuko ennamu ey’okuteesa okwo; ku ddaala erisingayo wansi kuba kwa nsi oba kwa mubiri, bwe kutaba kwa Setaani. Ate era, omuntu ddala alina omukisa— Atayimirira mu kkubo ly’abalina ebibi. Ebinyonyi eby’ebyoya ebifaanagana bibuukira wamu; ekkubo ly’omwonoonyi terisaanira mukkiriza wa mazima, nga n’ekkubo ly’omukkiriza bwe litasaanira mwonoonyi. Nga mujulirwa wa Mukama we, ng’asuubira okulokola ababula, ayinza okugenda gye bali; naye tajja, nga Lutti, kusimba weema ye ng’agitunuza e Sodomu; aleme okugwa mu mutego nga Lutti, eyawona yekka, ng’afiiriddwa bonna be yali asinga okwagala, n’ebintu bye byonna. Woowe, bazadde bameka abaawuluguttanga okumpi n’omuliro ng’ebiwojjolo, abalabye abaana baabwe nga gubazikiriza, ate bo bennyini ne batawona bisago! Kkanisa mmeka n’ebitongole by’Ekikristaayo, mu kugezaako okusikiriza abatakyuse n’ebisikiriza eby’ensi oba eby’okwesanyusaamu, bo bennyini abafiiriddwa omukisa gwa Katonda; ne bafiirwa amaanyi ag’omwoyo bwe batyo, ne kiba nti abo be baasikiriza tebaganyuddwa n’akatono! Mu kifo ky’okulaba abafu nga bazuukizibwa, embeera ey’okutongotoka n’okufa ebayingiddemu bo bennyini. Tewali bwetaavu, wadde ebbanga, ery’ekisikiriza ekirala kyonna okuggyako ekyo Kristo yennyini kye yawa, bwe yagamba nti, "Bwe ndiwanikibwa ... ndiwalulira bonna gye ndi." Mukama waffe bulijjo yali "eyayawulibwa okuva ku abo abalina ebibi," era Omwoyo Omutukuvu ayogera mu ngeri etabuusibwabuusibwa mu 2 Abakkolinso 6: "Nkolagana ki eriwo wakati w’obutuukirivu n’obujeemu, oba kutabagana ki okuliwo wakati w’ekitangaala n’ekizikiza? ... Kubanga ffenna tuli Yeekaalu ya Katonda omulamu. Nga Katonda bwe yagamba nti, Nnaabeeranga mu bo era natambuliranga mu bo, nnaabeeranga Katonda waabwe, nabo banaabeeranga bantu bange. Noolwekyo muve wakati mu bo, mubeeyawuleko ... Temukwata ku bitali birongoofu, nange nnaabaaniriza. Era nnaabeeranga Kitammwe, nammwe ne mubeeranga batabani bange ne bawala bange, bw’ayogera Mukama Ayinzabyonna." "Newaakubadde okutuula n’abo abanyooma ebya Katonda." Entebe y’abanyoomi kye kimu ku bizibu eby’enjawulo eby’omulembe guno. Amalala, okwetulinkiriza, n’okunyooma bikwatagana nnyo, era biri wala nnyo n’endowooza eyali mu Kristo Yesu. Omwoyo guno gutera okweyoleka leero mu ngeri y’okunenya okutaliimu kitiibwa. Abo abasinga obutasaanira mu by’omwoyo basangibwa nga batudde ku ntebe y’okusala emisango, mu kifo ky’okutwala ekifo ky’oyo abuuza era ayiga. Ab’e Beroya ab’edda tebaagaana na kunyooma njigiriza z’Omutume Pawulo, ezaali empya gye bali, wabula baakeneenyanga Ebyawandiikibwa buli lunaku okulaba obanga ebyo bwe biri bwe bityo. Kaakano, mazima, Ebyawandiikibwa byennyini bibuusibwabuusibwa, era emisingi gyennyini egy’okukkiriza okw’Ekikristaayo girekebwa abantu abandyagadde okutwalibwa ng’abatume b’endowooza ez’omulembe guno. Katonda akuume abantu be baleme kuleka kukkiriza abatukuvu kwe baaweebwa omulundi ogumu, olw’ebirowoozo eby’ekiseera ebitaliiko musingi eby’omulembe guno! OBUKWAKKULIZO OBW’OKUKOLA OBUTUUSA KU MUKISA. Tulowoozezza ku bintu omuntu ddala alina omukisa by’eyewala. Ayi, ennaku n’okufiirwa kw’abo abalemererwa okubyewala! Kaakano tulina okulowooza ku mbala ez’enjawulo ez’omuntu wa Katonda, ezo ezibeera omulundi gumu ensibuko y’amaanyi ge n’engabo ye ey’obukuumi. "Asanyukira okugondera amateeka ga Mukama; "Era mu mateeka ago mw’alowooleza emisana n’ekiro." Abatazaalibwanga mulundi gwa kubiri tebasobola kusanyukira mateeka ga Mukama. Bayinza okuba ab’eddiini ennyo, ne basoma Baibuli ng’emu ku mirimu gyabwe egy’eddiini. Bayinza okwewuunya bingi ebiri mu Baibuli, ne bagitendereza n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka—kubanga ng’ekitabo kyokka kye kisingayo okwewuunyisa mu nsi. Weewaawo, bayinza okusingawo; ne balowooza, nga Sawulo omuyigganya bwe yalowooza, nti obulamu bwabwe bulungamizibwa enjigiriza zaayo, so nga bakyali wala ne Katonda. Naye abantu ng’abo bwe bakyuka, bazuula nti babadde bazibe b’amaaso; mu "bintu byonna" ebifuuka ebiggya, basanga nga bafunye Baibuli empya; era ng’abaana abawere abaakazaalibwa beegomba amata ag’Ekigambo amalongoofu agatali matabule, balyoke bakulire omwo. Kirungi Abakristaayo abato bwe baliisibwa obulungi Ekigambo kya Katonda, n’obuwoomi bwabwe ne butayonoonebwa, wadde embeera yaabwe ey’omwoyo okuzikirizibwa, olw’okulya ebirowoozo by’abantu mu kifo ky’amazima ga Katonda. Si kizibu kumanya omuntu ky’asanyukira. "Akamwa koogera ku biba bijjudde mu mutima." Maama asanyuka okwogera ku mwana we omuwere, omunnabyabufuzi ayagala okwogera ku byobufuzi, omunnassaayansi ku ssaayansi gy’asinga okwagala, n’omuzannyi ku muzannyo gwe. Mu ngeri y’emu Omukristaayo omunyiikivu era omusanyufu alaga essanyu lye mu Kigambo kya Katonda; kye kyokulya kye era ekimubudaabuda; kye kyokusoma kye era kye kimulungamya; era Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’ayaka ekitangaala ekiggya ku mazima gaakyo ag’omuwendo, akisangamu essanyu n’okunyumirwa ebitageraageranyizika. Mu ngeri ey’obutonde, ajja kutera okwogera ku ekyo eky’omuwendo ennyo eri omutima gwe. Olw’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, omukkiriza, bw’amala okufuuka omwana wa Katonda, asanga eby’okwegomba n’okuyiga ebiggya mu mirimu gyonna egya Katonda. Kitaawe ye yagiteekateeka n’agitonda, agiwanirira era agikozesa, era gibeerawo olw’ekitiibwa kye. Naye kino kituufu nnyo naddala ku Kigambo kya Katonda. Ng’alina endowooza ya Kristo, ng’ayigirizibwa Omwoyo wa Kristo, asanga mu buli kitundu ky’Ekigambo kya Katonda obujulizi ku muntu ne ku mulimu gwa Mukama we era Mukwano gwe asaanidde okusinzibwa. Baibuli mu ngeri lukumi yeeyagaza gy’ali, nga bw’ebikkula endowooza n’amakubo ga Katonda, engeri gye yakolagananga n’abantu be mu biseera eby’edda, n’okubikkula kwe okw’ekitalo okw’ebiseera ebigenda okujja. Bw’asoma bw’atyo Ekigambo kya Katonda, omukkiriza afuna ensibuko empya ey’essanyu; si ekyo kyokka ekibikkuliddwa kye kiba eky’omuwendo, naye n’obulungi n’obutuukirivu bw’okubikkula kwennyini byeyongera okumukwata. Teyeetaaga bujulizi obuva ebweru okukakasa nti kyaluŋŋamizibwa; wonna wonna kiriko akabonero k’Obwakatonda. Era nga ekyuma ekigaziya ebintu ebitono ennyo bwe kiraga obukalubo n’obulema bw’emirimu gy’omuntu naye ne kiraga mu bujjuvu okusingawo obutuukirivu bw’emirimu gya Katonda, ne kireeta mu lwatu obulungi obuggya obutalowoozebwangako, bwe kityo bwe kiri n’Ekigambo kya Katonda bwe kyekenneenyezebwa n’obwegendereza. Ekitabo kino nga kyawukana ekitalo ku mirimu gy’abantu! Ssaayansi ow’eggulo talina mugaso leero; naye ebyafaayo n’ebizuuliddwa mu biseera byaffe bino bikakasa nti ebiwandiiko bino eby’edda ebitukuvu byesigika. Gye tukoma okuba n’okukkiriza okw’amaanyi nti Ekigambo kya Katonda Ekitukuvu kyaluŋŋamizibwa kyonna, buli kigambo kyakyo, era gye tukoma okukifuula omulagirizi waffe, era gye tukoma okugoberera enjigiriza zaakyo awatali kubuusabuusa, emirembe gyaffe gye ginaakoma okuba egy’obuziba n’obuweereza bwaffe okubala ebibala. "Abo abaagala amateeka go bali mu ddembe lingi; tewali kisobola kubeesittaza." Ng’agenda yeeyongera okukakasa amagezi ag’obwakatonda ag’ebiragiro n’amateeka g’Ebyawandiikibwa, n’okwesigika kw’ebisuubizo, obulamu bw’omukkiriza bujja kugenda bufuuka obw’obuwulize n’obwesige; era bw’atyo ajja kwekakasiza yekka nga Katonda by’ayagala bwe biri ebirungi, ebisiimibwa, era ebituukiridde, era ne Baibuli eyo ebibikkula. Ebigambo, "amateeka ga Mukama," bye tutegeera okutegeeza Ekigambo kya Katonda kyonna, birimu amakulu mangi. Biraga nti Baibuli egenderera okutuyigiriza Katonda ky’ayagala tukole; nti tetusaanidde kunoonya bisuubizo byokka, n’okugezaako okufuna byonna bye tusobola okuva eri Katonda; naye okwegomba ennyo okusingawo okumanya ky’ayagala tubeere era kye tusaanidde okukola ku lulwe. Kyawandiikibwa ku Ezera nti yateekateeka omutima gwe okunoonya Etteeka lya Mukama, alyoke alikole, era ayigirize mu Isirayiri amateeka n’ebiragiro. Ekyavaamu kwe kuba nti omukono gwa Katonda we gwali ku ye olw’obulungi, ebyo omutima gwe bye gwegomba ne bimuweebwa mu bungi, n’afuuka omukutu gw’omukisa eri abantu be bonna. Buli anoonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa mu mwoyo gwe gumu ajja kufuna omukisa gwa Katonda n’agugabira n’abalala: ajja kusangamu obulagirizi bw’ayetaaga ku lw’obuweereza bwe yennyini, era emirundi mingi ekigambo eky’omu kiseera ekituufu eri abo b’akolagana nabo. Naye Baibuli tejja kumubeerera Mateeka ga Mukama mu kumuyigiriza Katonda by’ayagala abeere era akole kyokka, naye okusingawo mu kubikkula Katonda yennyini ky’ali era by’akola. Nga etteeka ly’obuzito (gravitation) bwe lituleetera okumanya engeri amaanyi ge tuyinza okwesiga bulijjo gye ganaakolamu mu mbeera ezimu, bwe gatyo Amateeka ga Mukama gatuleetera okumumanya ye, n’emisingi gy’obufuzi bwe, gye tuyinza okwesiga n’obwesige obutaliimu kubuusabuusa. Omuntu wa Katonda ajja kusanyuka okulondoola Katonda mu Kigambo ng’Omukozi omukulu, era asanyukire enkizo ey’okuba omukozi awamu naye—omukozi omusanyufu ow’okwagala kwe mu kukola Katonda by’ayagala, kyokka ng’asanyukira ekisa ekimufudde omwagazi, n’amaanyi ag’obwakatonda ag’ensusso agakolera mu ye. Baibuli era ejja kumuyigiriza okwetunuulira ng’akasirikitu kokka, nga bwe kyandigambiddwa, mu nsi yonna ennene eya Katonda; n’okulaba omulimu omunene ogwa Katonda ng’ekintu ekimu ekijjuvu eky’ekitalo, ekikolebwa okuyita mu mikutu emitwalo n’emitwalo; mu bifo byonna, mu biseera byonna, era awatali kusoboka kulemererwa ku nkomerero—okweyoleka okw’ekitiibwa okw’obutuukirivu bw’Omukozi omukulu! Ye, n’abaweereza banne abalala lukumi, bayinza okuggwaawo; naye ekirowoozo kino tekijja kulemaza kufuba kwe, kubanga amanyi nti kyonna ekikoleddwa mu Katonda kijja kubeerawo, era nti kyonna ekitannaggwa ng’omulimu gwe guwedde, Omukozi omukulu ajja kukimaliriza mu kiseera kye era mu ngeri ye. Tasuubira kutegeera byonna ebikwata ku mulimu omunene ogwo gw’aweereddwa enkizo okutwalamu ekitundu eky’omukisa naye ekitono ennyo; asobola okulindirira okuggwa kwagwo, era asobola dda okusanyuka olw’okukkiriza mu bukakafu nti gwonna gulisangibwa nga gusaanira mu buli ngeri Omuteesi omukulu era Omutuukiriza waagwo. Kya nsonga essanyu lye okuba mu Mateeka ga Mukama, n’okugalowoolezaamu emisana n’ekiro. EBIVAAMU EBY’OMUKISA. Kaakano tweyongerayo okulaba ebisuubizo eby’ekitalo ebiri mu lunyiriri olw’okusatu olwa Zabbuli eno—kimu ku bisinga okwewuunyisa era okuzingiramu ebingi ebiri mu Byawandiikibwa:— "Afaanana ng’omuti ogwasimbibwa ku mabbali g’omugga, "Ogubala ebibala byagwo mu ntuuko zaabyo, "N’ebikoola byagwo tebiwotoka. "Na buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere." Singa twali tusobola okuwa abatatya Katonda enteekateeka ey’ensi ekakasa nti bajja kukulaakulana mu byonna bye bakola, nga bandigisembezza n’amaanyi! Naye Katonda yennyini bw’abikkulira abantu be enteekateeka ekola ddala, nga batono abagikozesa! Bangi balemererwa ku ludda olw’okwewala ne batava mu nsi mu lwatu; bangi balemererwa ku ludda olw’okukola ne bakkiriza emirimu emirala oba okwesanyusa okutwala ebiseera ebyandiweereddwa okusoma n’okufumiitiriza ku Kigambo kya Katonda. Eri abamu si kyangu okufuna ebiseera eby’okutunula ku makya, naye tewali kiyinza kuliyirira kufiirwa kwabyo. Naye tewali kibinja kya kusatu ky’Abakristaayo ng’okulemererwa kwabwe okusinga kuva mu butakwata kisuubizo ne bakyetwalira olw’okukkiriza? Mu buli emu ku ngeri zino essatu okulemererwa kuyinza okuyingira, n’emikisa egy’endagaano ne gifiirwa. Kale kaakano tulowooze emikisa gye giri, essanyu ery’engeri ennyingi, okukkiriza lye kulina okwetwalira obukwakkulizo bwe bumala okutuukirizibwa. I. Obutebenkevu.—Afaanana ng’omuti (so si kimera obuti eky’ekiseera kimu), ogukula mpola nga gweyongera okubala ebibala. Omuti ogwasimbibwa, era ogusangibwa bulijjo mu kifo kyagwo, ogutawuubwawuubwa mpewo, nga si kya kuzannyisa mu mbeera. Ebimuli biyinza okumulisa ne biggwaawo, naye omuti gubeerawo. II. Ebigabwa Ebyetongodde.—Ogwasimbibwa ku mabbali g’emigga gy’amazzi. Ebigabwa ebya bulijjo eby’enkuba n’omusulo biyinza okuggwaawo: ebigabwa bye eby’obuziba era ebikwekeddwa tebisobola. Tajja kweraliikirira mu mwaka ogw’ekyeya, era mu nnaku ez’enjala ajja kukkuta. Ekigabwa kye ge mazzi amalamu—Omwoyo wa Katonda—oyo atakyukakyuka, eggulo, leero, n’emirembe gyonna: kyava aba nga tasinziira ku nsulo ekulukuta oluusi n’ekalira oluusi. III. Okubala Ebibala mu Ntuuko Zaabyo.—Omuyizi w’Ebyawandiikibwa omwegendereza alaba okufaanagana wakati w’enjigiriza ya Zabbuli Eyasooka n’eya Mukama waffe mu Njiri ya Yokaana, gye tuyigirizibwa mu ssuula ey’omukaaga nti oyo alya Kristo abeera mu ye, ne mu ey’ekkumi n’ettaano nti oyo abeera mu ye abala ebibala bingi. Tulya Kristo, Kigambo eyafuuka omubiri, okuyita mu Kigambo ekyawandiikibwa. Bwe kityo ne mu Zabbuli eno, oyo asanyukira amateeka ga Mukama, n’agafumiitirizaako emisana n’ekiro, abala ebibala bye mu ntuuko zaabyo. Kino kirungi. Ekigambo ekyogeddwa mu kiseera ekituufu nga kirungi; era nga n’okutunula okw’omu kiseera ekituufu kuyinza okuzzaamu amaanyi oba okuziyiza, okunenya oba okubudaabuda! Ekisuubizo kino kijjukiza ebyo ebiri mu Yokaana ebikwata ku mazzi amalamu: abalumwa ennyonta bagenywa, ne batakoma ku kuweweera bokka, naye ne bafuuka emikutu emigga gy’amazzi amalamu mwe gikulukutira bulijjo, abalala abalumwa ennyonta balyoke bafune okuweweera okw’omu kiseera ekituufu mu ssaawa yaabwe ey’obwetaavu. Naye ekifaananyi ekiri mu Zabbuli si kya mazzi agakulukutira mu ffe ng’agayita mu mukutu; wabula kya kibala, ekiva ddala mu bulamu bwaffe bwennyini obukyusiddwa—obulamu obw’okwegatta ne Kristo. Kisa kinene nnyo eri Katonda waffe obutakolera mu ffe mu ngeri ya kyuma bwereere, wabula okutufuula amatabi g’Omuzabbibu Ogw’amazima, ebitundu byennyini mwe gubalira ebibala byagwo. Noolwekyo, tetuli bakozi abeetongodde, kubanga waliwo enjawulo ey’omusingi wakati w’ekibala n’omulimu. Omulimu guva mu kufuba; ekibala, mu bulamu. Omuntu omubi ayinza okukola omulimu omulungi, naye omuti omubi teguyinza kubala bibala birungi. Ekiva mu mulimu tekizaala, naye ekibala kirina ensigo yaakyo mu kyo kyennyini. Omukozi alina okunoonya ebikozesebwa bye n’ebyuma bye, era emirundi mingi okwewaayo eri omulimu gwe n’okugumiikiriza okulumya. Ekibala ky’Omuzabbibu kye kiva mu bulamu obuli munda mu ssanyu, mu ddembe, era mu ngeri ey’obutonde; era kitondekebwa ne kikula ne kyengera mu ntuuko zaakyo. Era kibala ki omukkiriza ky’asaanidde okubala? Tekiyinza kwogerwako mu kigambo kimu—okufaanana Kristo? Kisanyusa okwetegereza nti Ebyawandiikibwa tebyogera ku bibala by’Omwoyo, mu bungi, nga gy’obeera nti tuyinza okwerondera ku bisa ebyo ebyogeddwako, wabula ku kibala, mu kimu, ekiri ekirimba ekijjuvu ekikoleddwa mu kwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, n’ebirala. Nga kya mukisa okubala ebibala ng’ebyo mu ntuuko zaabyo! IV. Amaanyi Agatakoma.—"N’ebikoola byagwo tebiwotoka." Mu mbeera y’obudde ey’ewaffe emiti mingi gisobola okukuuma obulamu bwagyo okuyita mu biseera eby’obutiti, naye ne gitasobola kukuuma bikoola byagyo. Kyokka omuti ogugumu ogutakyusa bikoola, si ku kuba omulamu kwokka, naye gwolesa obulamu bwagwo, era okusingawo mu lwatu olw’amatabi ag’obwereere agaguli okumpi. Obulamu obuli munda bwa maanyi ne butatya lunaku olumpimpi, empewo ennyogovu, wadde omuzira ogugwa. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’omuntu wa Katonda obulamu bwe obukuumibwa olw’okukolagana okukwekeddwa okuyita mu Kigambo; okubonaabona kuleeta bulesi mu lwatu amaanyi n’amazima g’obulamu obuli munda. Ekikoola ky’omuti si kya kwewunda bwewunda. Obanga emirandira gitujjukiza amaanyi ag’okufuna kubanga gisika okuva mu ttaka amazzi g’omuti agazzaamu amaanyi, obulamu bwe butandisobodde kukuumibwa awatali go, n’ebikoola tebitujjukiza kitono ekisa ky’okugaba, n’eky’okulongoosa. Biwa empewo obunnyogovu obuweweeza; biwa omutambuze ekisiikirize ekiweweeza, era birongoosa empewo eyonooneddwa okussa kw’ebiramu. Era omuti gusasulwa bulungi olw’ebyo byonna bye guwaayo okuyita mu bikoola byagwo. Amazzi g’omuti agatali makwafu agazzaamu amaanyi agava mu mirandira, agatandisobodde gokka kuzimba muti, geeyongera obukwafu mu kuwaayo obunnyogovu bwago, era okuyita mu bikoola ne geefunira kaboni okuva mu mpewo. Bwe gagaggawazibwa, amazzi g’omuti gaddayo okuyita mu muti, nga gaguzimba okutuusa obulandira obusinga obutono nga buliisibwa ebikoola nga ebikoola bwe biriisibwa emirandira. Kuuma omuti nga gwambuddwako ebikoola byagwo okumala ebbanga eriwanvu ekimala, era gujja kufa. Bwe kityo omukkiriza bw’ataba ng’agaba era ng’afuna, ng’alongoosa obulamu bwe n’obuyinza bw’alina ku balala, tasobola kukula wadde okukuuma obulungi amaanyi g’obulamu bwe. Naye oyo asanyukira amateeka ga Mukama, n’agalowoolezaamu emisana n’ekiro—ebikoola bye tebiriwotoka. V. Okukulaakulana Okutakyukakyuka.—"Na buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere." Waliwo ekisuubizo ekiyinza okusukka kino? Kye kirabo eky’enjawulo eky’omwana wa Katonda okulaba omukono gwa Katonda mu mbeera ze zonna n’ebimwetoolodde, n’okuweereza Katonda mu mirimu gye gyonna n’obuvunaanyizibwa bwe. Ne bw’alya oba bw’anywa, bw’akola oba bw’awummula, bw’ayogera oba bw’asirika; mu mirimu gye gyonna, egy’omwoyo, egy’awaka, oba egy’ensi, aba mu ngeri y’emu omuweereza wa Katonda. Tewali kintu ekikkirizibwa gy’ali ekitono ennyo okuba nga tekiyinza kumuwa kakisa ka kugulumiza Katonda; emirimu egyandibadde emitono oba egikooya mu gyo gyokka gigulumizibwa ne giweebwa ekitiibwa omukkiriza bw’ategeera nti mu gyo asobola okusanyusa n’okumatiza omutima ogw’okwagala ogwa Mukama we atunula bulijjo. Era oyo amanyi mu byonna nti muweereza wa Katonda ayinza okwesiga okufuna ebimumala okuva eri Katonda olw’obwetaavu bwonna, era n’atunuulira eri Katonda n’essuubi eryesigika nti ddala anaamukulaakulanya mu buli ky’akola. Naye okukulaakulana kuno tekujja kulabika bulijjo, okuggyako eri eriiso ly’okukkiriza. Kolaziini ne Besusayida bwe baagaana obubaka bwa Mukama waffe, kyetaagisa eriiso ly’okukkiriza okusanyuka mu mwoyo n’okugamba nti, "Weewaawo Kitange, bw’otyo bwe wasiima." Tewali kubuusabuusa nti eggye ly’emisambwa gya ggeyeena lyajaganya bwe lyalaba Mukama ow’Ekitiibwa ng’akomererwa ku muti ogwakolimirwa; naye tumanyi nti tewali kiseera Mukama waffe ow’omukisa lwe yakulaakulana okusinga lwe yeewaayo yekka, nga Kabona waffe Asinga Obukulu, okuba ssaddaaka yaffe etutangirira, n’asitula ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe ku muti. Nga bwe kyali olwo, bwe kiri ne kaakano, ekkubo ly’okukulaakulana okw’amazima litera okuyita mu kubonaabona okusingayo obuziba; abagoberezi ba Kristo basaanidde okumatira n’ekkubo lye yatambulirako. Naye newaakubadde nga okukulaakulana kuno kuyinza obutalabika mangu, bulijjo kunaabanga kwa mazima, era kusaanidde bulijjo okwetwalirwa olw’okukkiriza. Omusumba mu kkanisa ye, omuminsani mu bantu abatamanyi Katonda, omusuubuzi ku mmeeza ye, maama mu maka ge, omukozi mu mulimu gwe, buli omu ku bo ayinza mu ngeri y’emu okukwetwalira. Si kwa bwereere nti kyawandiikibwa nti, "Na buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere." VI. Ekisembayo, twetegereze nti ebisuubizo bino byonna biri mu ngeri ey’okutegeeza ekiriwo (indicative mood), era, kasita obukwakkulizo butuukirizibwa, tebiriimu kubuusabuusa. Tebiriimu "oboolyawo" yonna. Era ate, bikolebwa eri abakkiriza kinoomu. Abakkiriza abalala bwe balemererwa, oyo abikkiriza ye tajja kulemererwa; ekigambo kiri nti, "Na buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere." ENJAWULO. "Abakola ebibi tebakola bwe batyo." Tekyetaagisa kulwawo ku njawulo eno. Abatatya Katonda tebayinza kunyumirwa ssanyu ly’omwana wa Katonda, kubanga tebasobola kutuukiriza bukwakkulizo. Tebasobola, era tebaagala, kwewala kuteesa, kibiina, wadde amakubo ga banaabwe; era tebalina kulaba okw’omwoyo okwetaagisa okusanyukira Ekigambo kya Katonda. Mu kifo ky’okujjula obulamu, ng’empeke ezikyali ennyogovu, bakakanyala ne bakala; era omusana gwe gumu ogwengeza emu gutegeka endala okuzikirizibwa. Mu kifo ky’okuba nga "basimbiddwa," empewo ebafuumuula; era Oyo asanyukira ekkubo ly’abantu be, aleetera ekkubo ly’abatatya Katonda okubula.
